name: Sandbox custom images
description: Sandbox custom images capabilities. Includes API for custom sandbox base images, built on top of the VM sandbox base via an image-builder agent, Create a draft custom image and start its interactive image-builder agent task, Persist the image spec (from the request body or the builder agent's sandbox), run the security scan, and on pass build and publish the image., Rename or update the description of a custom image, Revive (or reuse) the image's builder agent session.
